Inside, you’ll find a bright and spacious layout featuring a lovely master bedroom with fitted wardrobes and a sleek en-suite, plus a second comfortable bedroom and an additional modern bathroom. The heart of the home is the open-plan kitchen and reception area, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, which opens out onto a private balcony — ideal for your morning coffee or evening unwind. Residents here enjoy fantastic added perks, including a 24-hour concierge service, an on-site gym and spa, and beautifully landscaped communal gardens. The interiors are stylish and thoughtfully designed throughout, and the apartment is offered furnished for your convenience. There’s even a Zero Deposit Guarantee option available, making moving in even easier. Hampstead itself is one of London’s most charming and desirable areas, known for its rich artistic and cultural heritage. It has a lovely village feel, with plenty to explore — from historic homes and museums to scenic spots and open-air events. One of the biggest highlights is Hampstead Heath, a vast and much-loved green space offering swimming ponds, walking trails, and plenty of activities for all ages. The local area is also packed with great places to eat and drink, from cosy traditional pubs to popular restaurants and cafés. Getting into central London couldn’t be simpler, with excellent transport links via bus, the Northern Line from Hampstead Station, or a short drive — making this an ideal home for commuters who want the best of both city life and peaceful surroundings. We like you, have had difficult experiences with Estate Agents in the past and know there's a better more transparent way. Industry experience has shown us the way - founding director's Luke & Tom have combined 20 years' experience working at established high street agencies, as well as opening new offices across North, Central and East London. They have both been right at the centre of the industry and have seen and experienced different agency approaches to a business they both feel extremely passionate about. As a new company in an industry dominated by some big players we know that reputation is everything. This shapes our entire company philosophy and we firmly believe that every interaction with us is a chance to build our reputation and ultimately our company. We believe the industry is at a crossroads and the digital agent has an opportunity to take the best of the traditional and integrate the latest technology and marketing tools to maximise exposure for each and every property and provide a cost effective and efficient service. We dont believe that shiny suits, branded cars and hard selling is the way forward. Times are changing and there is real gap for an honest and genuine agent who can give an efficient and personable service. Let's be honest buying, selling or renting are all stressful things and the agent should at the heart of making the process as easy as possible Read more Notes These notes are private, only you can see them.
